title: Balefires Burning
author: Cassandra Wolf
description:
Share the story of 15-year-old Tansy, who is on the verge of becoming an adult and a witch. In an isolated community where magic is an everyday occurrence and otherworldly beings walk the woods, you face challenges and learn to cope with your newly-awakened visionary senses.

Author's Comment: "This is the first chapter of a novel written with interactive elements, where you (the first person narrator) choose your reactions to the events of the story."
